newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Index on Estonian bourse continues to slide.
newsitem.headline: Index on Estonian bourse continues to slide.

text.p: Estonia's bourse index continued to slide on Wednesday amid a relatively brisk day of trading, the Tallinn Stock Exchange said.
Total market volume was almost 12 million kroons compared with 10.3 million kroons on Tuesday and the index fell by 0.10 percent to 105.24.

Union Bank, which recently issued new shares in a bid to raise its share capital, accounted for most of the turnover at 7.2 million kroons and it closed at 40.30 kroons versus 40.25 kroons on Tuesday.
Hansa Bank was also active at 4.2 million kroons and it closed at 106.50 kroons versus 106.65 kroons on Tuesday.
